world.everyday: a parade, a soda fountain, a scene that looks like an advert for itself

name: Tiki
tagline: Bamboo bars and a permanent holiday
description: A mid-century dream of the tropics, built in the suburbs: carved masks, rattan, bamboo, glowing pufferfish lamps and drinks with umbrellas in. Getting away from it all, built into a living room.

world.setting: a backyard pretending to be a South Sea island, string lights across the patio
world.architecture: an A-frame with a thatched bar and a carved post by the door
world.interior: rattan chairs, bamboo panelling, pufferfish lamps glowing amber
world.technology: a hi-fi playing exotica, a blender that never rests
world.clothes: loud floral shirts, sarongs, flower crowns, sandals
world.music: exotica, surf guitar, lounge records with birdcalls on them
world.colours: bamboo gold, burnt orange, jungle green, lagoon blue
world.everyday: friends round every weekend, drinks with names, sunsets watched on purpose

name: Prairiecore
tagline: Big sky, calico and a homestead to keep
description: Life on the open plains: calico dresses, wooden porches, wheat to the horizon and a kitchen that feeds whoever turns up. Hardworking, rooted and wide open.

world.setting: grassland to every horizon, one cottonwood by the creek
world.architecture: a timber homestead with a wide porch and a windmill out back
world.interior: patchwork quilts, a cast-iron stove, jars on every shelf
world.technology: a hand pump, an oil lamp, a radio for the weather and nothing else
world.clothes: calico dresses, aprons, work boots, a sun bonnet
world.music: fiddle tunes, hymns on the porch, wind through the grass
world.colours: wheat gold, prairie sky blue, barn red, flour white
world.everyday: up before the sun, chores till noon, neighbours to supper

name: Gardencore
tagline: A life arranged around what grows
description: Seed packets, muddy knees, a greenhouse warm on a cold day and a table full of what came up this week. A home measured in seasons and bean rows.

world.setting: an allotment behind the houses, a robin following the spade
world.architecture: a cottage with a glasshouse leaning on its south wall
world.interior: seedlings on every windowsill, twine and labels in a biscuit tin
world.technology: a hose, a seed-saving notebook, a weather app checked twice a day
world.clothes: dungarees, gardening gloves, wellies by the back door
world.music: birdsong, a radio play, gentle acoustic songs
world.colours: leaf green, terracotta, soil brown, petal white
world.everyday: watering at dawn, weeding in the evening, sharing the courgette glut

name: Urbancore
tagline: Graffiti, concrete and the right trainers
description: Street life as a look: graffiti, parking lots, rooftops and alleyways, with streetwear and expensive trainers to match. Youthful, a bit rebellious and rooted in real cities of the last few decades.

world.setting: a city that never fully goes dark, a skate park at night, trains rumbling under the street
world.architecture: underpasses, fire escapes, worn-down buildings between skyscrapers
world.interior: a small room with trainers in boxes and a view of rooftops and water towers
world.technology: transit cards, a speaker in a backpack, a phone for filming the trick
world.clothes: baggy cargos, a puffer jacket, a cap, Jordans kept clean
world.music: hip-hop, R&B, a beat from a passing car
world.colours: concrete grey, black, spray-paint colours, taxi yellow
world.everyday: a different neighbourhood every weekend, the rooftop at dusk, knowing which wall just got painted

name: Cozycore
tagline: Blankets, warm light and nowhere to be
description: A home built entirely around comfort: thick socks, soft lamps, a mug that stays warm and a pile of things to read. The rain is welcome because it means staying in.

world.setting: a small town in late autumn, rain on the window by four o'clock
world.architecture: a snug flat with deep windowsills and a radiator that clanks
world.interior: throws over everything, fairy lights, a reading nook made of cushions
world.technology: a slow cooker, an e-reader, a playlist made for rainy days
world.clothes: oversized knitwear, thick socks, soft joggers
world.music: lo-fi beats, acoustic covers, the crackle of a fireplace video
world.colours: oatmeal, cinnamon, warm brown, candle gold
world.everyday: tea at every hour, a film under a blanket, plans gladly cancelled

name: Space Age
tagline: White plastic, round windows and the moon in reach
description: Sixties design that believed the future had arrived: egg chairs, moulded plastic, sunken lounges and silver everything. A home built like a capsule, ready for launch.

world.setting: a hillside house above a city of the future, 1968
world.architecture: a white pod on stilts with round windows and a curved roof
world.interior: egg chairs, a sunken lounge, shag rug, a lamp shaped like a mushroom
world.technology: a television in a sphere, a reel-to-reel, a telephone with buttons
world.clothes: mod shift dresses, white boots, silver jackets, helmets for style
world.music: space-age pop, moog records, lounge with sci-fi sound effects
world.colours: white plastic, tangerine, silver, midnight blue
world.everyday: parties in the lounge, launches on the television, dreaming of the moon

name: Midwest Gothic
tagline: Cornfields, empty roads and something not quite right
description: The flat, quiet unease of the American countryside: grain silos, a water tower, flickering gas stations and a long straight road at night. Ordinary on the surface, eerie just beneath.

world.setting: a two-stoplight town in a sea of corn, the next one forty miles away
world.architecture: a farmhouse with a storm cellar and a porch light left on for no one
world.interior: wood panelling, a wall calendar from the feed store, a ticking clock
world.technology: a CB radio, a pickup that needs coaxing, a landline that rings once at night
world.clothes: work jackets, faded caps, boots caked with clay
world.music: slow country, droning guitars, a gospel station fading in and out
world.colours: corn yellow, sky grey, rust, porch-light amber
world.everyday: the same diner every morning, a long drive at dusk, not asking about the barn

name: Lo-fi
tagline: Rain on the window, beats on loop, homework on the desk
description: The calm of a late-night study session: muted colours, an animated window, a cat on the sill and soft beats that never end. Gentle, focused and a little nostalgic.

world.setting: a city at night seen from a high window, rain on the glass
world.architecture: a small apartment block with lit windows all the way up
world.interior: a desk lamp, a stack of notebooks, a plant, a cat asleep on the sill
world.technology: headphones, a laptop with a looping stream, a cassette player for show
world.clothes: big hoodies, headphones round the neck, comfy socks
world.music: chillhop, jazzy beats, vinyl crackle, rain sounds
world.colours: dusk blue, peach lamp-light, faded purple, cream
world.everyday: study by night, tea gone cold, the same playlist till dawn

name: Arcadecore
tagline: Neon carpet, tokens and the sound of a high score
description: The bleeping, flashing, carpeted world of the arcade: cabinets glowing in the dark, prize counters, tokens in a paper cup and the thrill of one more go.

world.setting: a strip-mall arcade on a summer night, the car park still warm
world.architecture: a low building with a flashing sign and blacked-out windows
world.interior: patterned cosmic carpet, rows of glowing cabinets, a ticket counter
world.technology: joysticks, light guns, a token machine that eats notes
world.clothes: graphic tees, high-top trainers, a bomber jacket
world.music: chiptune, synth pop, the jingle of the attract screen
world.colours: neon pink, electric blue, ultraviolet, black
world.everyday: a cup of tokens, initials on the leaderboard, pizza after

name: Autumn
tagline: Crunching leaves and a warm cup in cold hands
description: The happy-sad feeling of the year changing: amber light, falling leaves, woolly scarves, apple picking and the first fire of the season. Cosy and a little sad.

world.setting: a small town in October, leaves banked up along the kerb
world.architecture: a red-brick house with a porch full of pumpkins
world.interior: a fire lit for the first time this year, candles, a bowl of apples
world.technology: a kettle, a record player, a camera for the trees on the way home
world.clothes: chunky scarves, corduroy, boots, a jumper borrowed and never returned
world.music: acoustic folk, film scores, rain on a tin roof
world.colours: rust, pumpkin orange, mustard, deep brown
world.everyday: apple picking, long walks, soup on the stove, early dark and no complaints

name: Spring
tagline: The first warm day after a long grey one
description: Blossom, rain-washed streets and light that finally lasts past dinner. Fresh, hopeful and a little giddy: windows open, pastel jumpers, flowers on every table.

world.setting: a park the week the cherry trees open, puddles still on the paths
world.architecture: a terrace with a glasshouse, window boxes just planted
world.interior: a vase of tulips, curtains pulled back, the heating finally off
world.technology: a phone for photographing blossom, a kettle, a radio by the window
world.clothes: a light mac, pastel knits, trainers that can take a puddle
world.music: light indie, birdsong, acoustic guitar with the window open
world.colours: blossom pink, new-leaf green, butter yellow, rain-sky blue
world.everyday: picnics too early in the year, repotting plants, walking home the long way

name: Summer
tagline: Long light, bare feet and nowhere to be
description: Sun on skin, salt in your hair and evenings that will not end. Beaches, open roads, ice lollies and friends in a garden until dark: loud, easy and golden.

world.setting: a beach at six in the evening, towels still out and nobody leaving
world.architecture: a seaside promenade, a garden with a long table and string lights
world.interior: a room with the shutters half closed, sand in the hallway
world.technology: a disposable camera, a speaker running out of battery, a fan
world.clothes: sunglasses, linen shirts, a swimsuit under everything, sandals
world.music: summer pop, a car radio with the windows down, waves
world.colours: sea blue, sun yellow, coral, sand white
world.everyday: swimming before breakfast, ice cream for dinner, staying up because it is still light

name: Winter
tagline: Snow outside, a blanket and a lamp inside
description: Still white mornings, frost on the glass and early dark. Quiet and a little hushed: wool, candles, hot drinks and the particular cosiness of being warm while it is cold.

world.setting: a street after the first snow, footprints and one lit window
world.architecture: a wooden cabin with a snow-heavy roof, a church with its door open
world.interior: a wool blanket, candles on the sill, a radiator with socks drying
world.technology: a kettle, string lights, an old radio with the news low
world.clothes: a long coat, a hat pulled down, thick socks, mittens on a string
world.music: quiet piano, choirs from a distance, a record by the fire
world.colours: snow white, frost blue, charcoal, candle gold
world.everyday: stamping off boots, soup, reading under a blanket, watching it snow

name: 90s Cool
tagline: Black leather, bullet time and green code raining down
description: The action-film look of 1997-2004 after The Matrix: slow-motion fight scenes full of computer effects, long black coats, wraparound sunglasses and a screen-green tint over everything. Cool, armoured and convinced the world is a simulation.

world.setting: a rooftop in the rain, a hallway lined with pillars that are about to be shot to pieces
world.architecture: concrete, tinted glass, an empty subway station at night
world.interior: a bare room with a single chair and a CRT showing static
world.technology: a ringing landline, a slider phone, green text scrolling past
world.clothes: a floor-length black coat, combat boots, tiny dark sunglasses
world.music: big beat, industrial rock, a drum-and-bass trailer cut
world.colours: black, gunmetal, terminal green
world.everyday: walking like the camera is always on you

name: Gen X Soft Club
tagline: A quiet train station, a cool blue sky and a Chemical Brothers cover
description: The calmer, more grown-up side of millennium futurism, strongest in the UK around 1998-2004: city skylines, airports, underground metros, plants, clean sans-serif type and cool blues. Optimistic, but with a hangover.

world.setting: an airport at dawn, a metro platform with a big blue poster
world.architecture: glass terminals, concrete underpasses, a skyline seen from a train
world.interior: a minimal flat with one large plant and a stack of CDs
world.technology: a minidisc player, a slim Nokia, a laptop with a blurred city wallpaper
world.clothes: a technical jacket, straight jeans, muted trainers
world.music: electronica, trip-hop, post-Britpop
world.colours: cool blue, slate, white, a hint of moss green
world.everyday: headphones on, staring out of the train window

name: Bright Tertiaries
tagline: Lime, purple, orange and teal on every corporate wall
description: The mid-2000s to mid-2010s style of blocky, upbeat colour: lime green, purple, orange and teal on logos, office interiors, gadgets and leaflets. Friendly, corporate and impossible to miss.

world.setting: an office reception with a lime-green feature wall
world.architecture: a school or library refurbished in 2008 with colour-blocked panels
world.interior: a purple sofa, an orange pouffe, teal carpet tiles
world.technology: a lime-green phone, a teal laptop sleeve, a purple MP3 player
world.clothes: a bright hoodie in a colour you would only find in a brochure
world.music: cheerful indie-pop from an advert
world.colours: lime, purple, orange, teal
world.everyday: reading a leaflet that promises the future is fun

name: Technozen
tagline: A Wii menu, a quiet train and a cute robot
description: The calm, clean side of mid-to-late 2000s Japanese technology: the Wii and DS, Aibo and Asimo, brain-training games, flip phones and electronic dictionaries. Cool, sterile and professional, and at the same time soft, friendly and cute.

world.setting: a quiet commuter train in Tokyo, a living room with the Wii menu on
world.architecture: a clean white station, a convenience store at night
world.interior: white furniture, soft light, a small robot dog asleep in the corner
world.technology: a Wii, a DS with a stylus, a flip phone, an electronic dictionary
world.clothes: neat, soft layers in white and light grey
world.music: the Wii menu, the Mii channel, a gentle piano loop
world.colours: white, pale sky blue, light grey
world.everyday: a brain-training session on the train home
